spanish: Y en descender el rocío sobre el campamento de noche, descendía el maná sobre él.

findings.issue: Bare noun לָיְלָה is smoothed as adverbial de noche; the time concept is licensed and no extra event is added.

notes: Infinitive and imperfect of H3381, the dew, the camp, the manna, and the 3ms upon-it suffix are all present.
